## What changes and why

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues where relevant.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. Explain checks that could not
be run. Include screenshots for visible UI changes where useful.

## Compatibility and data

Describe any effects on existing collections, translations, export identities,
storage formats, supported platforms or dependencies. Write "None" if not applicable.

## Checklist
